قِرْأَةٌ The وَبَآء [by which is here meant the common, or general, disease] (As, S, O, K) of a country; (S, O;) of which it is said that when a person has come to that country and remained in it fifteen nights [or days, accord. to one of my copies of the S,] the قرأة thereof quits him; or, as the people of El-Hijáz say, its قِرَة; meaning that if he be affected with a malady after that, it will not be from the وبآء [or قرأة] of the country: (As, S, O;) and it is also termed ↓ قِرْءٌ . (TA. [But I think it not improbable that this last word may have originated in a mistranscription of قِرَةٌ.]) ＝
-A2- See also 4, second sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
